column1: # The 13 mitochondrial protein-coding genes (PCGs) plus the two ribosomal RNA
# genes, used by the mitogenome workflow (code/analysis/20-26, run_mito.sh).
# One row per gene. `type` = pcg (translated with the invertebrate mitochondrial
# genetic code, NCBI transl_table 5) or rrna. Every reference probe is fetched
# at ORDER level (Ixodida = all ticks), because the sample set spans both
# Ixodidae (hard ticks) and Argasidae (soft ticks) -- families separated by
# >200 My, too divergent for a family- or genus-restricted probe to reliably
# find both. tblastn on the well-conserved PCGs is what carries that span, not
# nucleotide identity, which is why every pcg row is searched with tblastn
# against a protein probe, never blastn.
# Edit this file to add/drop a gene; nothing is hardcoded in the scripts.
